title: Public answers to who Frequency is for leave out most families, and the Portfolio Teacher has no door
detail:
PR 8 (ADR-1715). funnel-config doors gain an archetypes field (coaches-and-healers: Second-Act Practitioner; studios: Studio Keeper; event-hosts: Gathering Host; community-builders: Host-Connector and Network Steward; nonprofits: Network Steward) plus a new /for/teachers door for the Portfolio Teacher; pricing who it is for lines name teachers across studios and people running many small groups, and Crew speaks to supporters; what-is-frequency names every family in plain words; the stored home page and spaces template; llms.txt and llms-full.txt carry a Who Frequency is for section with no archetype names; the start page adds a run a studio or practice card and an activity entry; the upgrade page adds so it stays free for everyone. Coordinate pricing-grid.ts and pricing-page.ts with the pricing ladder thread.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. Every funnel door carries an archetypes field (internal, never rendered); /for/teachers is the Portfolio Teacher door, routed to business:programs with a Teacher choice in the Space wizard; llms.txt and llms-full.txt carry a Who Frequency is for list from lib/marketing/who-its-for.ts with no archetype names; What is Frequency names every family; /start links Run a studio or a practice and adds a something-to-do entry; the upgrade page says so it stays free for everyone. Pricing (owner ask 2026-10-06 20:26): the Business who-it-is-for line names teachers who work across studios, Crew speaks to people backing the community, the persona loadouts gain a teachers door, and the Spaces menu links For teachers. The Spaces page template names teachers across studios, second-career practitioners and studio owners. The stored home page is a follow-up.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const f=r("lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts");if(!/slug:\s*.teachers/.test(f))fail("there is no /for/teachers door for teachers who work across studios");for(const a of ["portfolio_teacher","second_act","studio_keeper","network_steward"])if(!f.includes(a))fail("no funnel door is keyed to the "+a+" archetype");if(!/Who Frequency is for/.test(r("app/llms.txt/route.ts")))fail("llms.txt has no Who Frequency is for section");const w=r("lib/page-editor/templates/what-is-frequency.ts");for(const x of [/just moved/i,/run club/i,/timer/i,/teacher/i,/studio/i])if(!x.test(w))fail("the Who is Frequency for answer leaves out a family: "+x)'
verify.note: Fails while /for/teachers is missing, a Builder archetype has no door, llms.txt lacks the section, or the Who is Frequency for answer leaves out a family.
